display.summary: Outbound calls go through the Composer agent so a generated stack can keep web and celery off the internet; weather is the first feature on it, and the compatibility contracts scheduled for 1.10.0 are removed.
highlights: The Composer agent makes outbound calls for the project through a small, typed channel (Composer 1.6.0 or newer), with API keys sealed so only the agent can read them; projects declare their own calls in relay/operations.json.
Weather works on a generated stack with no change to compose.yml, and the settings page says which fix applies when a search fails.
Composer performs every inline update: DLUX_UPDATE_EXECUTOR and the in-container executor, `enable-updater` and `enable-agent` are removed (use `./start.sh check --fix`).
`advanced_filter_helper`, the `archive_file` widget names and the `AUDIT_FIELD_NAMES` alias are removed.
Also new since 1.9: project settings in first-run setup and grouped tiles, per-user and per-group landing pages, and a missing Celery reported on Options.
